title: 2.8.2.1 crashes when switching the phone from flight mode to normal
symptom: When switching the phone from flight mode to normal mode, AAPS disappears (crashes) without freezing. The issue occurs on a BlackBerry Key2 LE running Android 8 with Bluetooth and NFC on during flight mode.
fix: There is no official fix. A workaround mentioned is restarting Ruffy and then AAPS.
evidence_quote: There are workarounds for the crash: restarting Ruffy and then AAPS (if someone else asks....).
